blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diet is a major determinant of health, yet accurate dietary assessment from free-living meal images remains challenging. Existing retrieval-based Vision-Language Model (VLM) approaches to nutrient estimation typically rely on textual food representations, while, to our knowledge, direct grounding on visually similar annotated meals has not been investigated. We present NutriVisRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework that uses a vision encoder to retrieve similar meals with known nutritional annotations and provide them as multimodal in-context exemplars for VLM nutrient estimation at inference time, without task-specific fine-tuning. We evaluate NutriVisRAG across four datasets, four VLMs, three retrieval encoders, and two prompting strategies, including free-living meals from adults with insulin-treated diabetes, where carbohydrate estimates are compared against two dietitians' annotations. Across all 96 configurations (4 datasets x 4 VLMs x 3 retrieval encoders x 2 prompting strategies), NutriVisRAG reduced the primary estimation error in 56, with improvements more frequent under whole-meal (35/48) than per-item prompting (21/48). Across the evaluated configurations, the lowest NutriVisRAG error was below the best Vanilla error in 13 of 16 VLM--dataset pairs. For GPT-5.4-mini, under whole-meal prompting, the best-performing retrieval encoder for each dataset reduced the primary error on all four datasets relative to Vanilla, with reductions of 1.7--35.7%. Overall, our results show that grounding in multimodal exemplars comprising images and respective annotations can improve nutrient estimation at inference time without task-specific fine-tuning, although the benefits remain configuration-dependent.
blocks.zh: 饮食是健康的一个主要决定因素,然而,根据免费膳食图像进行准确的饮食评估仍然具有挑战性。 现有的基于检索的Visual-Langage Model(VLM)的营养素估计方法通常依赖于文字食物表示,而据我们所知,没有调查直接基于视觉上类似的附加说明的餐食。 我们提出Nutri VisRAG,这是一个回收增强的生成框架,它使用一个视觉编码器来取回有已知营养说明的类似膳食,并作为在推论时间对VLM营养素进行估算的多模式内附实例提供,而不进行特定任务的微调。 我们评价Nutri VisRAG的四套数据、四套VLM数据、三套检索编码器和两套促动策略,包括用胰岛素治疗糖尿病的成年人的免费膳食,将碳水化合物估计数与两位饮食学家的说明进行比较。 在所有96个配置(4个数据集x4个VLMx3个检索编码器x2个提示策略)中,NutriVisRAG减少了56个主估计误差,全米(35/48)下改进的频率高于每个项目提示(21/48)。 在整个评估的配置中,最低的NutriVisRAG误差低于16对VLM-数据集中13对最佳的Vanilla误差. 对GPT-5.4-mini来说,在全餐提示下,每个数据集最有性能的检索编码器会减少所有四个数据集相对于香草的主要错误,减少1.7-35.7%. 总体而言,我们的结果表明,在包含图像和相应说明的多式联运范例中扎根,可以改进推断时的养分估计,而无需对具体任务进行微调,尽管效益仍然取决于配置。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Accurate dietary assessment is central to nutritional monitoring and the prevention and management of diet-related chronic diseases, yet conventional self-reported approaches remain burdensome and prone to measurement errors [ 17 ] .
Advances in computer vision and smartphone technologies have enabled automated dietary assessment from meal images through multi-stage pipelines combining food segmentation, recognition, portion estimation, and nutrient calculation, alongside integrated models that directly predict food quantity and nutritional composition [ 29 , 28 , 51 , 43 , 44 ] .
These approaches have benefited from increasingly large food segmentation and recognition datasets [ 11 , 30 , 31 , 46 ] .
Errors in either segmentation or recognition can propagate to downstream portion and nutrient estimation, and recognition remains particularly vulnerable to distributions not represented during training [ 4 ] .
Even when food regions and identities are correctly determined, estimating physical quantity remains a separate challenge, as portion estimation typically relies on depth, geometric reconstruction, or reference cues that require additional acquisition information [ 29 , 28 , 51 , 43 , 2 ] .
End-to-end models instead bypass this by predicting food weight, energy, or macronutrients from visual representations.
However, these approaches require large training datasets with quantitative dietary annotations [ 51 , 44 , 50 ] .
blocks.zh:
准确的饮食评估是营养监测、与饮食有关的慢性疾病的预防和管理的核心,但传统的自报方法仍然繁琐,容易出现衡量错误[17]。
计算机视觉和智能手机技术的进步,使得能够通过多阶段管道,结合食物分解、识别、部分估计和养分计算,以及直接预测食物数量和营养成分的综合模型,从膳食图像中进行饮食自动评估[29、28、51、43、44]。
这些办法得益于日益庞大的食品分和识别数据集[11、30、31、46]。
分化或识别方面的错误可以传播到下游部分和营养素估计,而识别仍然特别容易受到培训期间没有反映的分布的影响[4]。
即使在正确确定粮食区域和特性的情况下,估计实物数量仍是一个单独的挑战,因为部分估计通常依赖于深度、几何重建或需要额外获取信息的参考提示[29、28、51、43、2]。
端到端模型则通过从视觉表现中预测食物重量,能量,或宏观营养素来绕过这一点.
然而,这些方法需要大型的培训数据集,并附有定量饮食说明[51、44、50]。

blocks.en:
Large Language Models, pretrained on large-scale text corpora, have demonstrated strong few-shot and in-context learning capabilities across diverse language tasks without task-specific fine-tuning [ 13 , 10 ] .
Extending this foundation-model paradigm to visual inputs, Vision-Language Models (VLMs) combine language modelling with visual representations to support multimodal understanding and generation [ 45 , 6 ] .
Recent studies have evaluated VLMs for food recognition, meal decomposition, portion and weight estimation, calorie estimation, and macronutrient prediction, with performance varying substantially across models and prompting strategies [ 1 , 47 , 58 , 39 , 50 , 34 , 53 , 49 ] .
Task-specific fine-tuning, specialised prediction components, and parameter-efficient adaptation can improve performance, but require additional dietary training data and model adaptation [ 1 , 58 , 50 ] .
Nevertheless, quantitative dietary estimation remains challenging because food quantity and nutritional content must still be inferred from limited visual information [ 39 , 50 , 34 , 53 , 55 , 8 , 49 ] .
Explicitly supplied nutritional information can nevertheless improve nutrient estimation [ 34 , 50 ] .
blocks.zh:
大语言 模型在大规模文本corpora上经过预先训练,在各种语言任务中展现出强大的几发和内文本学习能力,而没有针对具体任务的微调[13,10].
将这一基础模型范式扩展至可视化输入,Visual-Language Models(VLMs)将语言建模和可视化表示结合起来,支持多模式理解和生成[45,6].
最近的研究评估了食品识别、膳食分解、部分和重量估计、卡路里估计和宏观营养素预测的VLM,各模型的性能差别很大,并提出了战略[1、47、58、39、50、34、53、49]。
针对具体任务的微调、专门预测成分和参数效率的适应可以提高性能,但需要额外的饮食培训数据和模型适应[1、58、50]。
然而,定量饮食估计仍然具有挑战性,因为食物数量和营养含量仍然必须从有限的视觉信息中推断[39、50、34、53、55、8、49]。
然而,明确提供的营养信息可以改善营养估计[34、50]。

blocks.en:
Structured, retrieval-augmented, and agentic approaches have therefore been explored for VLM-based dietary assessment [ 1 , 8 , 16 ] .
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) provides inference-time access to external evidence without requiring fine-tuning of VLMs [ 25 ] .
In dietary applications, retrieval has been used to support food identification and nutrient estimation through dietary records, food composition databases, knowledge graphs, and standardised nutritional information [ 18 , 57 , 62 , 16 , 5 ] .
However, current dietary retrieval remains predominantly textual or structured.
Image-based approaches first interpret meal images into textual descriptions, candidate foods, or decomposed food items before querying external food composition resources [ 57 , 16 ] .
Multimodal RAG has shown that retrieval can operate directly over visual and heterogeneous representations [ 15 , 21 , 59 ] , while visual retrieval has previously been explored in food computing for image-recipe matching and calorie estimation [ 48 , 33 ] .
To the best of our knowledge, however, VLM-based nutrient estimation applications have yet to investigate the retrieval of visually similar meal images with known nutritional annotations and provide them directly to the VLM for grounding.
blocks.zh:
因此,已经探索了结构化、回收化和代理化的方法,以便进行基于自愿减量的饮食评估[1、8、16]。
检索增强生成(RAG)提供推断时间取用外部证据,而不需要微调VLM[25].
在饮食应用中,通过饮食记录、食物组成数据库、知识图和标准化营养信息[18、57、62、16、5],利用检索支持食物鉴定和营养估计。
然而,目前的饮食检索仍然主要是文字或结构。
基于图像的方法首先将食用图像解释成文字描述,候选食品,或分解食品,然后再查询外部食物组成资源[57,16].
多式联运RAG表明,检索可以直接在视觉和多样的表示方式上进行[15、21、59],而视觉检索原先在用于图像-检索匹配和卡路里估计的食物计算中已经探索过[48、33]。
然而,就我们所知,基于VLM的营养素估计应用尚未调查有已知营养说明的视相相类似的食用图像的取回情况,并直接提供给VLM作地基测量。

blocks.en:
We therefore investigate whether simple inference-time grounding with visually similar annotated meals can improve VLM-based nutrient estimation.
Our contributions are: • We introduce NutriVisRAG , an inference-time framework that integrates image-based retrieval with pretrained VLMs, using similar annotated meals as multimodal in-context exemplars for nutrient estimation. • We systematically evaluate visual exemplar grounding across VLMs, retrieval encoders, prompting strategies, and four dietary datasets, including free-living meals from adults with insulin-treated diabetes evaluated against dietitians’ visual estimations.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们调查简单的推论时间与视觉上类似的附加说明的膳食能否改善基于VLM的营养素估计。
• 我们的贡献是: 我们引入了Nutri VisRAG,这是一种推论时间框架,将基于图像的检索与经过预先训练的VLM相结合,使用类似的附加说明的餐具作为营养素估计的多式内文实例。 我们系统地评估视觉实例,包括VLM、检索编码器、激励策略和四个饮食数据集,包括根据饮食师的视觉估计来评估患有胰岛素治疗糖尿病的成年人的免费膳食。

blocks.en: We introduce NutriVisRAG , an inference-time framework that integrates image-based retrieval with pretrained VLMs, using similar annotated meals as multimodal in-context exemplars for nutrient estimation.

blocks.zh: 2.1 努特里维斯拉格

blocks.en: Overview
blocks.zh: 概览

blocks.en:
NutriVisRAG, illustrated in Figure 1 , retrieves visually similar annotated meals directly in the visual embedding space and provides each retrieved meal image together with its available nutritional annotations to a VLM as multimodal context at test time.
Retrieval is followed by a single VLM generation step for nutrient estimation.
The retrieved meals therefore act as multimodal in-context exemplars carrying both visual and quantitative information [ 25 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh:
如图1所示,Nutri VisRAG在视觉嵌入空间直接取回了视觉上类似的附加说明的餐食,并在测试时将每张取回的餐食图像连同其现有的营养说明作为多模式上下文提供给VLM。
检索之后是单一的VLM生成步骤来进行营养素估计.
因此,取回的餐具可作为载有视觉和定量信息的多式文体实例[25,6]。

blocks.en: 2.2 Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.2 数据集

blocks.en: We use four dietary image datasets (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们使用四个饮食图像数据集(表1)。

blocks.en: Nutrition5k [ 51 ] contains cafeteria meals acquired under controlled conditions, with ingredient-level food identities and weights and meal-level weight, energy, and macronutrient annotations.
blocks.zh: 营养5k[51]包含在控制条件下获得的食堂膳食,有成分级食物特征和重量以及膳食级体重,能量,和宏观营养说明.

blocks.en: SNAPMe [ 24 ] contains free-living meal images captured from smartphones and linked to dietary records collected using the Automated Self-Administered 24-hour Dietary Assessment Tool (ASA24), providing verified self-reported annotations for energy and macronutrients without measured meal weight.
blocks.zh: SNAPMe [24] 载有从智能手机中获取的免费活餐图像,并与使用自动自备24小时饮食评估工具(ASA24)收集的饮食记录相链接,提供了未经计量的膳食重量的能量和宏观营养素的经核实的自报说明.

blocks.en:
MADiMa [ 7 ] contains 80 meals with two to four food items and measured weight, volume, and energy and macronutrient composition.
Each meal was captured at 40 cm and 60 cm under a constrained acquisition protocol, yielding 160 images used jointly in the main evaluation.
The two acquisition distances are additionally analysed as separate 80-image subsets in Supplementary Section S2.
blocks.zh:
MADIMA[7]包含有80个餐点,有2到4个食物项目,并测量了重量,体积,能量和宏观营养成分.
每餐以40厘米和60厘米的速度被按照受限的收购协议捕获,产生160个图像,在主评价中共同使用.
补充部分S2将两个获取距离作为单独的80-图像子集加以分析。

blocks.en:
EDUCATE [ 12 ] contains free-living meal images captured using the goFOOD ™ Lite mobile application [ 28 ] from adults with insulin-treated diabetes in the Netherlands arm of the study [ 12 ] .
After excluding packaged foods, erroneous entries, and non-food images, de-identified food-only images from 25 participants were retained.
CHO content was independently estimated by two dietitians using an annotation tool [ 3 ] , and model estimates are evaluated against their mean in the absence of measured ground truth.
blocks.zh:
EDUCATE [12] 包含使用goFOOD TM LITE移动应用程序捕获的来自研究荷兰臂部有胰岛素治疗糖尿病的成年人的免费用餐图像 [12].
在排除了包装食品,错误条目和非食品图像后,保留了来自25名参与者的去识别的仅食品图像.
CHO的内容是由两位饮食学家使用注释工具独立估计的[3],在没有测量出地面真实性的情况下,模型估计按其平均值来评价.

blocks.en:
Nutrition5k and SNAPMe serve as both evaluation query sets and indexed reference corpora.
For each of Nutrition5k and SNAPMe, a subset (exact numbers in Table 1 ) is held out for evaluation, and the remaining are combined into the reference corpus, ensuring that evaluated meals cannot be retrieved as references.
Despite annotation provenance differences, the two reference subsets are combined to broaden the range of meal compositions and acquisition conditions represented, spanning controlled and free-living settings.
Nutrition5k queries are drawn from overhead, non-empty meals, while SNAPMe queries are selected round-robin at image level with preference for compositionally rich plates.
The task-specific Nutrition5k split does not follow the official partition and was designed to retain compositionally richer dishes in the reference corpus.
blocks.zh:
营养5k和SNAPMe既是评价查询组,也是索引参考公司。
对于营养5k和SNAPMe,都保留一个子集(表1中的确切数字)以供评价,其余部分合并为参考文献,确保无法取回评估过的膳食作为参考文献。
尽管有注释来源的差异,但两个参考子集被合并,以扩大所代表、跨越受控制和自由生活环境的膳食组成和获取条件的范围。
营养5k的查询取自于非空餐的起居费,而SNAPMe的查询则取自于图像层面的圆形robin,偏好成分丰富的盘子.

blocks.en:
We evaluate two prompting strategies differing in the granularity of the requested output.
In per-item , the VLM was asked to identify the visible food items and estimate the weight, energy, CHO, protein, and fat of each item separately, with meal-level estimates obtained by summing the returned item-level predictions.
In whole-meal , the VLM was asked to directly estimate the corresponding totals for the complete meal without explicit item-level decomposition.
For each strategy, the same task instructions and enforced structured JSON output format are used in the Vanilla and grounded conditions.
The grounded condition additionally receives the retrieved reference images with their nutritional annotations and a system-prompt description of this reference information.
The exact prompt templates are provided in Supplementary Section S1.

在全餐中,VLM被要求直接估算全餐的相应总量而无需明确项目级分解.
对每项战略,在香草和有根据的条件下使用相同的任务指示和强制性结构化的JSON产出格式。

Beyond these retrieval-parameter ablations, we evaluate two exploratory extensions on the same fixed 100-query subsets.
Both extensions are evaluated across all four VLMs.
For post-hoc food-composition grounding, we match VLM-predicted food names to food-composition database entries using lexical token-set similarity or one of three text-embedding models: Qwen3-Embedding [ 61 ] , EmbeddingGemma [ 54 ] , and Nomic Embed Text v2 (MoE) [ 36 ] .
The matched nutrient values are scaled by the VLM-predicted food weights and summed to obtain meal-level estimates.
This analysis uses per-item predictions, which provide the food identities and corresponding weights required for database lookup.
For retrieval reranking, each query retrieves 50 visual candidates, which are rescored using Jina Reranker M0 [ 22 ] , Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B [ 26 ] , or Llama Nemotron Rerank VL 1B v2 [ 38 ] .
The five highest-ranked references are then provided to the VLM under both prompting strategies.
These analyses test whether more selective exemplar ranking or external food-composition lookup improves the base NutriVisRAG estimates, respectively.
Full experimental details and results are reported in Supplementary Section S5.

blocks.en: 3.1 NutriVisRAG versus Vanilla VLM Inference
blocks.zh: 3.1 努特里维斯拉格与瓦尼利亚VLM 推论

blocks.en:
We first evaluate whether visually retrieved meals with known nutritional annotations improve nutrient estimation relative to Vanilla VLM inference.
Table 4 reports the primary error, with complete per-nutrient results in Supplementary Table S1.
Across 96 configurations (4 datasets × \times 4 VLMs × \times 3 retrieval encoders × \times 2 prompting strategies), NutriVisRAG reduces the corresponding Vanilla error in 56, with improvements more frequent under whole-meal (35/48) than per-item prompting (21/48).
After Benjamini–Hochberg correction, 45 configurations show a significant reduction in error, while 23 show a significant increase.
Whole-meal prompting may benefit more from retrieval since exemplar annotations directly match the requested meal-level totals, unlike per-item prompting, which requires additional decomposition and aggregation.
blocks.zh:
我们首先评估有已知营养说明的可视取食是否比Vanilla VLM推论改善了营养估计。
表4报告了主要错误,补充表S1中包含完整的人均营养值结果。
跨96个配置(4个数据集x\times 4个VLMxx\times 3个检索编码器xxxtimes 2个提示策略),NutriVisRAG减少56个对应的香草出错,在整餐(35/48)下改进更频繁于每个项目提示(21/48).
在Benjamini-Hochberg校正后,45个配置显示误差显著减少,而23个配置显示显著增加.
整餐提示可能从检索中得到更多的好处,因为示例说明直接与所要求的餐级总计相匹配,与每个项目提示不同,这需要额外的分解和聚合.

blocks.en:
Using the primary % MAE micro/CHO \mathrm{\%MAE}_{\text{micro/CHO}} metric, NutriVisRAG reduces error in 13/24 configurations on Nutrition5k, 7/24 on SNAPMe, 22/24 on MADiMa, and 14/24 on EDUCATE.
Nutrient-specific effects are broader, particularly for CHO, with improvements in 18/24, 9/24, 24/24, and 14/24 configurations, respectively; on MADiMa, weight and energy also improve in 21/24 and 19/24 configurations (Supplementary Table S1).
Despite contributing indexed references, SNAPMe benefits least consistently, while MADiMa and EDUCATE show more frequent gains despite stronger projected separation from the reference corpus under some encoders (Supplementary Fig. S2).
Thus, corpus membership and projected embedding overlap alone do not determine retrieval effectiveness.
SNAPMe and EDUCATE should be interpreted with their annotation sources in mind: SNAPMe uses verified self-reported dietary estimates, whereas EDUCATE is restricted to CHO compared to dietitians’ mean estimates, which are not nutritional ground truth.
Across the evaluated configurations, the lowest NutriVisRAG error is below the best Vanilla error in 13 of 16 VLM–query-set pairs.
As a retrieval-only control, we predict each nutritional target as the cosine-similarity-weighted mean of the retained exemplar annotations, without VLM inference.
The lowest NutriVisRAG error is below the best retrieval-only error on all four query sets, by 5.8, 8.3, 12.7, and 7.1 percentage points on Nutrition5k, SNAPMe, MADiMa, and EDUCATE, respectively.
Thus, direct similarity-weighted neighbour averaging does not account for the lowest observed NutriVisRAG errors.
blocks.zh:
使用初级% MAE 微/CHO \ mathrm\ MAE\ text{微博/ CHO} 度量衡, 努特里维斯 RAG减少营养问题13/24、SNAPME问题7/24、MADIMA问题22/24和EDUCATE问题14/24组合的错误。
对营养物的具体影响更为广泛,特别是对曹操而言,在18/24、9/24、24/24和14/24的配置方面都有所改进;对MADIMA而言,重量和能量在21/24和19/24的配置方面也有所改进(补充表S1)。
尽管SNAPMe提供了索引参考文献,但受益最少,而MADIMA和EDUCATE则显示出更经常的收益,尽管在一些编码器下,预计与参考文献的分离将更为有力(补充图.S2)。
因此,单凭实体成员资格和预计的重叠并不能确定检索的有效性。
SNAPME和EDUCATE应该从注释来源出发来解释:SNAPME使用经核实的自我报告的饮食估计,而EDUCATE则仅限于CHO,而饮食学家的平均值则不是营养基础的真实性。
在整个评估的配置中,最低的NutriVisRAG误差低于16个VLM-query-set对中13个最好的Vanilla误差.
作为一种只进行取回的控制,我们预测每个营养目标作为所保留的示例说明的同位素-同位素-加权平均值,没有VLM推论.
最低的NutriVisRAG误差低于所有四套查询中最好的只检索误差,分别比营养5k、SNAPME、MADIMA和EDUCATE差5.8、8.3、12.7和7.1个百分点。
因此,直接相近的加权邻居平均比率并不反映观察到的NutriVisRAG最低误差。

blocks.en:
The response to retrieval is strongly VLM-dependent, with improvements in 19/24 configurations for GPT-5.4-mini, 16/24 for GLM-5.3-Flash, 14/24 for Gemma-4-31B, and 7/24 for Mistral-Small-3.2.
Mistral-Small-3.2 shows substantial error increases under per-item prompting on Nutrition5k and SNAPMe but benefits from whole-meal grounding on Nutrition5k and MADiMa, whereas GPT-5.4-mini benefits more consistently across prompting strategies on Nutrition5k, MADiMa, and EDUCATE and GLM-5.3-Flash shows strong gains on MADiMa and EDUCATE.
Model scale alone does not explain these differences: Mistral-Small-3.2 is a 24B dense model, Gemma-4-31B has 31B parameters, GLM-5.3-Flash has 320B total and 18B active parameters, and GPT-5.4-mini’s parameter count is undisclosed, while architecture, training data, and post-training are not independently controlled [ 32 , 20 , 60 , 42 ] .

对检索的反应强烈依赖VLM,改进了GPT-5.4-mini的19/24配置,GLM-5.3-Flash的16/24配置,Gemma-4-31B的14/24配置和Mistral-Small-3.2的7/24配置。
Mistral-Small-3.2显示,在每一项目下,引起营养5k和SNAPMe的误差明显增加,但从营养5k和MADIMA的全膳基数中得益,而GPT-5.4-mini的误差在营养5k、MADIMA、EDUCATE和GLM-5.3-Flash的促动战略中更为一致地显示,MADIMA和EDUCATE取得了很大进展。
模型尺度本身并不能解释这些差异:Mistral-Small-3.2是一个24B稠密的模型,Gemma-4-31B有31B参数,GLM-5.3-Flash有320B总参数和18B活性参数,而GPT-5.4-mini的参数计数没有被披露,而架构,训练数据,以及后训练则没有独立的控制[32,20,60,42].

blocks.en:
No retrieval encoder consistently dominates across individual model–query-set–prompt configurations (Table 4 and Supplementary Table S1).
Although cross-dataset means (Supplementary Table S2) favour PE-Core in several VLM–prompt combinations, the best encoder changes across query sets, and the direction of the retrieval effect can also change for the same VLM and prompting strategy.
Overall, NutriVisRAG provides clear but configuration-dependent gains, while improvements in % MAE micro/CHO \mathrm{\%MAE}_{\text{micro/CHO}} do not extend to every nutritional target.

blocks.en: 3.2 Effect of Prompting Strategy
blocks.zh: 3.2 迅速战略的效果

Figure 3 compares per-item and whole-meal prompting under Vanilla VLM inference.

Although per-item prompting performs better under Vanilla inference in most pairs, NutriVisRAG improves more frequently under whole-meal prompting, showing that stronger baseline prompt performance does not necessarily imply greater retrieval benefit.

blocks.en: 3.3 Exemplar Similarity and Retrieval Benefit
blocks.zh: 3.3 类似性和追索性福利

blocks.en:
Since retrieval improves estimation in many but not all configurations, we examine whether its benefit is associated with exemplar similarity.
A preliminary t-SNE analysis (Supplementary Fig. S2) showed that greater projected query–reference overlap does not correspond to more consistent gains, with MADiMa benefiting strongly despite its separation under PE-Core and SigLIP 2.
At the individual-query level, Figure 4 relates retrieval benefit to visual similarity and retrospective nutritional distance under both prompting strategies.
Visual similarity shows weak and inconsistent associations with retrieval gains across query sets and encoders.
In contrast, nutritional distance is more consistently negatively associated with benefit under whole-meal prompting, most strongly on MADiMa, and less so under per-item prompting.
Visual similarity also corresponds to nutritional proximity more clearly on Nutrition5k than on the other query sets (Supplementary Fig. S5).
Together, projected embedding overlap and cosine similarity alone therefore do not reliably predict exemplar usefulness.
The nutritional-distance analysis is retrospective, as query annotations are unavailable at inference time and are shared with the error metric, so the association is descriptive rather than causal.

相比之下,营养距离在全餐促动下与福利有着更一致的负面联系,在MADIMA上最为强烈,在逐项促动下则不那么强烈。

blocks.en: Effect of Similarity Threshold

Compared with τ = 0 \tau=0 , the default yields lower % MAE micro/CHO \mathrm{\%MAE}_{\text{micro/CHO}} in 60/96 configurations, including 32/48 per-item and 28/48 whole-meal configurations.
Lower error is seen in 10/24 configurations on Nutrition5k, 18/24 on SNAPMe, 13/24 on MADiMa, and 19/24 on EDUCATE, with seven significant comparisons all favouring the default threshold.
Where thresholding does not alter the retained exemplar set, observed differences cannot be attributed to exemplar filtering and may instead reflect inference variability.
Similarity filtering benefit many configurations, but its effect remains model-, dataset-, and encoder-dependent, and cosine similarity alone does not guarantee nutritional relevance.

blocks.en: Exploratory Retrieval Extensions
blocks.zh: 探索检索扩展

blocks.en:
For each post-hoc food-composition matching method, we evaluate 48 configurations (4 query sets × \times 4 VLMs × \times 3 visual encoders) using per-item predictions.
Post-hoc food-composition grounding increases % MAE micro/CHO \mathrm{\%MAE}_{\text{micro/CHO}} relative to the default NutriVisRAG predictions.
Lexical matching, EmbeddingGemma, and Nomic Embed Text v2 increase the error in all 48 configurations, while Qwen3-Embedding increases it in 46/48.
For energy, which is available for three query sets, the original NutriVisRAG predictions also yield lower error in 34/36 configurations (3 query sets × \times 4 VLMs × \times 3 visual encoders).
No matching method yields a significant improvement, while significant degradations occur in 45/48 configurations for lexical matching, 30/48 for Qwen3-Embedding, 47/48 for EmbeddingGemma, and 42/48 for Nomic Embed Text v2.
Because these stages were not evaluated independently, the degradations may reflect cumulative pipeline errors rather than inadequate matching models.

匹配方法没有产生显著改善,而用于语法匹配的45/48配置、用于Qune3-Embedding的30/48配置、用于EmbeddingGemma的47/48配置和用于Nomic Embed Text v2的42/48配置则出现显著退化。
由于这些阶段没有进行独立的评估,降解可能反映累积的管道出错,而不是匹配模型不足.

blocks.en:
For reranking, each prompting strategy comprises 144 comparisons (4 query sets × \times 4 VLMs × \times 3 visual encoders × \times 3 rerankers), corresponding to 36 comparisons per query set.
Under per-item prompting, reranking reduces % MAE micro/CHO \mathrm{\%MAE}_{\text{micro/CHO}} in 73/144 comparisons, including 24/36 on MADiMa, 19/36 on Nutrition5k, 17/36 on EDUCATE, and 13/36 on SNAPMe.
Eight per-item improvements and two degradations remain significant.
Under whole-meal prompting, reranking reduces error in 76/144 comparisons, including 28/36 on MADiMa, 21/36 on EDUCATE, 17/36 on SNAPMe, and 10/36 on Nutrition5k.
Six whole-meal improvements and four degradations remain significant after correction.
Reranking can therefore recover more useful exemplars in some configurations, but the rerankers optimise general multimodal relevance rather than nutritional equivalence, so a semantically more relevant meal is not necessarily a better quantitative reference.
Reranking additionally adds a median of 5.3–11.7 s per meal, increasing end-to-end latency by 2.6 × 2.6\times – 5.1 × 5.1\times depending on the reranker and VLM.
Overall, its variable accuracy gains and additional computational cost do not support incorporating reranking into the default NutriVisRAG pipeline.

经校正后,有6个全餐改进和4个降解情况仍然显著.
因此,重新排序可以在某些配置中恢复更有用的实例,但重新排序者优化了一般多模式的相关性而不是营养等同性,因此,一顿更为相关的餐食并不一定是更好的定量参考.

blocks.en: 3.5 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 3.5 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
The findings remain specific to the evaluated VLMs, retrieval encoders, and combined reference corpus, whose coverage may not represent the diversity of real-world meals and whose annotations combine measured Nutrition5k quantities with participant-reported SNAPMe quantities.
Broader evaluation across VLM families, visual representations, and larger, more diverse reference corpora is needed, particularly as MADiMa and EDUCATE remain entirely outside the indexed corpus and EDUCATE is evaluated only for CHO against dietitians’ visual estimates rather than measured ground truth.
Ablations were conducted on fixed 100-query subsets rather than the full query sets, and their observed effects may not generalise to complete datasets.
Matched textual-retrieval and random-exemplar controls were not evaluated, limiting attribution of the observed gains specifically to visual similarity-based grounding.
We also fix the VLM input image size; future work should evaluate query and exemplar resolution independently to determine whether finer visual detail justifies greater visual-token usage and inference latency.
Our similarity analysis indicates that visual similarity is an imperfect proxy for exemplar usefulness, motivating more adaptive retrieval or reranking criteria that capture ingredient, portion, compositional, and quantitative relevance using information available at inference.
blocks.zh:
调查结果仍然针对经评价的VLM、检索编码器和综合参考书目,其覆盖范围可能不代表现实世界膳食的多样性,其说明将计量的营养量5k和参与者报告的SNAPM量结合起来。
尤其因为MADIMA和EDUCATE完全不在索引范围内, EDUCATE只根据饮食学家的视觉估计,
使用固定的100克子集而不是完整的查询集进行调试,其所观测到的效果可能无法概括完成数据集.
未评价匹配的文字检索和随机实例控制,将观察到的收益的归属具体限于基于视觉相似性的地面。
我们还修正了 VLM 输入图像大小;今后的工作应当独立评价查询和示例解析,以确定更细的视觉细节是否证明更多的可视调用和推论延迟是合理的.
我们的相似性分析表明,视觉相似性是不完善的代名词,可以用来解释其实用性,激发更多的适应性检索或重排标准,利用推断时可获得的信息捕捉成份、部分、组成和数量相关性。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced NutriVisRAG, an inference-time framework that grounds pretrained VLMs with visually retrieved meals and their nutritional annotations as multimodal quantitative exemplars, without task-specific fine-tuning.
Across four dietary datasets, four VLMs, three retrieval encoders, and two prompting strategies, the lowest observed NutriVisRAG error was below the best Vanilla error in 13 of 16 VLM–dataset pairs.
More importantly, our investigation shows that retrieval effectiveness is configuration-dependent and cannot be explained by visual similarity alone: benefits vary across VLMs and prompting strategies, while visually closer exemplars do not consistently correspond to greater downstream improvement or nutritional proximity.
The more consistent gains under whole-meal prompting further suggest that exemplar usefulness depends not only on what is retrieved, but also on how the retrieved evidence is presented and used by the VLM.
Retrieval ablations reinforce this interpretation, showing that similarity filtering is often beneficial while increasing retrieval depth provides no consistent accuracy benefit, and additional post-hoc grounding and reranking provide no consistently better alternative.
Future work should therefore investigate inference-time retrieval or reranking criteria that better capture exemplar usefulness without requiring query nutrient annotations, alongside finer-grained analyses of query–exemplar correspondence and evaluation using larger and more diverse reference corpora.

我们引入了Nutri VisRAG,这是一个推论时间框架,将预先训练的VLM与可视取回的餐具及其营养说明作为多式定量实例,而不针对具体任务的微调。

blocks.en: S4 Retrieval Diagnostics
blocks.zh: S4 检索诊断

blocks.en:
Unless otherwise stated, the exemplar-level diagnostics use the main retrieval configuration with K = 5 K=5 , τ = 0.75 \tau=0.75 , and the closest-reference fallback.
Retrieval benefit is defined as the per-query reduction in pooled absolute macronutrient error relative to Vanilla, normalised by the query-set mean target macronutrient sum; EDUCATE instead uses absolute CHO error normalised by mean annotated CHO.
Visual similarity is the mean cosine similarity between the query and its retrieved exemplars.
Nutritional distance is the mean absolute query–exemplar difference across the available macronutrients after normalising each nutrient by its query-set mean; EDUCATE uses CHO only.
Associations are quantified using Spearman’s rank coefficient ( ρ \rho ).

blocks.en: S4.1 Visual Retrieval Space
blocks.zh: S4.1 视觉检索空间

blocks.en:
Figure S2 qualitatively examines whether projected query–reference overlap in the visual retrieval embedding space corresponds to downstream NutriVisRAG gains.
For each encoder, t-SNE (perplexity 30, PCA initialisation, random seed 0) is applied with cosine distance jointly to the reference corpus and all query sets.
PE-Core and SigLIP 2 show stronger dataset-level separation, particularly for MADiMa and EDUCATE, whereas Nomic Vision shows greater mixing between queries and references.
However, projected overlap does not correspond directly to retrieval benefit: MADiMa improves in 22/24 configurations despite its separation under PE-Core and SigLIP 2, while SNAPMe improves in only 7/24 despite its training split contributing to the reference corpus.
Likewise, Nomic Vision’s greater mixing does not yield more consistent MADiMa gains, improving 6/8 configurations compared with 8/8 for PE-Core and SigLIP 2.
Because t-SNE can distort neighbourhood and global structure, this analysis is interpreted qualitatively and motivates the exemplar-level analyses below.
blocks.zh:
图S2从质量上审查了视觉检索嵌入空间中预测的查询-参考重叠是否与下游的NutriVisRAG收益相对应.
对于每个编码器,t-SNE(复杂度为30,PCA初始化,随机种子为0)与同位素距离一起被应用到参考物和所有查询集.
PE-Core和SigLIP 2显示数据集层次的分离更加有力,特别是MADIMA和EDUCATE,而Nomic Vision显示查询和参考的混合程度更大。
然而,预计的重叠并不直接与检索效益相对应:MADIMA在22/24配置中有所改进,尽管在PE-Core和SigLIP 2中进行了分离,而SNAPMe在7/24中则有所改进,尽管其培训分工有助于参考书目。
同样地,Nomic Vision的更大混合并不能产生更一致的MADIMA收益,与PE-Core和SigLIP 2的8/8相比,改进了6/8配置.
由于t-SNE可以扭曲邻里和全球结构,因此这一分析被从质量上解释,并激励下面的示例分析.

blocks.en: S4.2 VLM-Specific Similarity–Benefit Associations
blocks.zh: S4.2 VLM-特定相似性-受益协会

blocks.en:
The main paper summarises the association between retrieval benefit and exemplar similarity after averaging retrieval benefit across the four VLMs.
Figures S3 and S4 show the corresponding associations separately for each VLM under per-item and whole-meal prompting.
blocks.zh:
主要论文总结了在平均获得四大VLM的检索惠益之后,检索惠益与实例相似性之间的联系.
图S3和S4在逐项和整餐提示下分别显示每个VLM的相应关联.

blocks.en:
Visual similarity remains weak and inconsistent across VLMs, query sets, and retrieval encoders under both prompting strategies.
Nutritional distance shows more consistently negative associations under whole-meal prompting, particularly on MADiMa, whereas the relationship is weaker and less consistent under per-item prompting.
The VLM-specific results further show that retrieval benefit varies across models despite using the same retrieved evidence, consistent with the configuration-dependent effects observed in the main experiments.

VLM特有结果还进一步表明,不同模型的回取效益各不相同,尽管使用了相同的回取证据,这与主要实验中观察到的配置依赖效应是一致的.

blocks.en: S4.3 Visual Similarity and Nutritional Proximity
blocks.zh: S4.3 视觉相似性和营养接近性

blocks.en:
Because each retrieved meal image is provided together with its nutritional annotations, we additionally examine whether visually closer exemplars are also nutritionally closer to the query.
This analysis is independent of prompting strategy because the retrieved exemplars are fixed before VLM prompting.
Figure S5 shows that the relationship varies substantially across query sets.
Visual similarity is more strongly associated with nutritional proximity on Nutrition5k, with weaker associations on SNAPMe and MADiMa and little association on EDUCATE.
Thus, visually similar retrieval does not uniformly imply quantitatively similar nutritional annotations across datasets.
This provides additional context for the weak and inconsistent relationship between cosine similarity and downstream retrieval benefit.
blocks.zh:
由于每个检索到的食用图像都连同其营养说明一起提供,我们额外检查了视觉上更接近的例子是否也营养上更接近询问.
这一分析独立于催化策略,因为取回的示例在VLM催化前是固定的.
图S5显示,各个查询组之间的关系差别很大。
视觉相似性与营养接近度5k有关,在SNAPME和MADIMA方面联系较弱,在EDUCATE方面联系较少。
因此,视相类似的检索并不统一意味着各数据集的营养说明在数量上相似。
这为余弦相似性和下游回取效益之间弱而不一致的关系提供了额外的上下文.

Nutritional distance is calculated retrospectively from annotated query nutrients and is therefore unavailable as an inference-time retrieval criterion.
Moreover, nutritional distance and estimation error both depend on the annotated query targets, so their association with retrieval benefit should be interpreted descriptively rather than causally.

此外,营养距离和估计误差都取决于附加说明的查询目标,因此,它们与检索福利的联系应作描述性解释,而不是因果解释。

blocks.en: S4.4 Meal-Level Error and Agreement Analysis
blocks.zh: S4.4 膳食级误差和协议分析

blocks.en:
Having characterised the retrieved evidence and its association with estimation benefit, we next examine how these effects are distributed across individual meals.
We analyse NutriVisRAG at the meal level under both per-item and whole-meal prompting.
Whole-meal prompting shows more consistent retrieval benefits in the main experiments, reducing the primary error in 35 of 48 configurations compared with 21 of 48 under per-item prompting.
To avoid selecting a particular retrieval representation or VLM, the analysis includes all three visual encoders, all four VLMs, and all four query sets.
For the paired-error analysis, the per-meal quantity underlying % MAE micro \mathrm{\%MAE}_{\text{micro}} is the pooled absolute macronutrient error, | Δ ​ CHO | + | Δ ​ PROT | + | Δ ​ FAT | |\Delta\mathrm{CHO}|+|\Delta\mathrm{PROT}|+|\Delta\mathrm{FAT}| , expressed in grams; for EDUCATE, the corresponding quantity is absolute CHO error.
For the Bland–Altman analysis, the corresponding pooled predicted and reference macronutrient quantities, CHO ^ + PROT ^ + FAT ^ \widehat{\mathrm{CHO}}+\widehat{\mathrm{PROT}}+\widehat{\mathrm{FAT}} and CHO + PROT + FAT \mathrm{CHO}+\mathrm{PROT}+\mathrm{FAT} , are compared in grams, while EDUCATE uses predicted and reference CHO.
The analysis uses the main retrieval configuration throughout: the combined Nutrition5k–SNAPMe reference corpus, K = 5 K=5 , and the similarity threshold τ = 0.75 \tau=0.75 with the closest-reference fallback where applicable.
blocks.zh:
在将收集的证据及其与估计效益的联系定性之后,我们接下来审查这些影响如何在个人膳食中分配。
我们在逐个项目和整餐促销下分析膳食级的NutriVisRAG。
全餐提示显示在主要实验中更一致的检索效益,减少了48个配置中35个的主要错误,而每个项目提示下48个配置中21个的主要错误.
为了避免选择特定的检索代表或VLM,分析包括所有三个可视编码器,所有四个VLM,以及所有四个查询集.
对于配对-误差分析,基于% MAE micro\mathrm\MAE\text{micro}的人均数量是集合绝对宏观营养误差,% CHO + + + + + + + + + + FAT + → → Delta\mathrm{ CHO} 德尔塔- mathrm{ PROT} Delta\mathrm{FAT}|,以克表示; 对于EDUCATE,相应的数量为绝对CHO错误.
对于布兰德-阿尔特曼分析,对应的集合预测和参考的宏观营养量,CHO ^ + PROT ^ + FAT → glasshat → mathrm{ CHO\\\ gladhat → mathrm{ PROT\ gladhat → mathrm{ FAT}}和CHO + PROT\ mathrm{ FAT}用克来比较,而EDUCATE则使用预测和参考CHO.
分析使用整个主要检索配置:综合营养5k-SNAPME参考体,K = 5 K = 5,相似性阈值\ = 0.75\tau= 0.75,在适用的情况下,最接近参考回落.

blocks.en:
Figures S6 and S8 compare the absolute estimation error of Vanilla and NutriVisRAG for each meal under per-item and whole-meal prompting, respectively.
Whole-meal prompting yields a larger number of individually improved meals than per-item prompting in 37 of the 48 matched VLM–encoder–query-set panels.
More than half of the meals improve in 36/48 whole-meal panels compared with 26/48 per-item panels, consistent with the greater aggregate benefit of whole-meal retrieval.
However, the number of improved meals does not necessarily determine the aggregate error because % MAE micro/CHO \mathrm{\%MAE}_{\text{micro/CHO}} also depends on the magnitude of individual errors.
For example, GLM-5.3-Flash under whole-meal prompting improves more than half of Nutrition5k meals for all three retrieval encoders despite increasing the aggregate primary error in all three configurations.
The paired plots therefore show that retrieval can benefit a majority of meals while a smaller number of large degradations dominate the aggregate error.
blocks.zh:
图S6和S8分别比较了每个项目下每餐和整餐促销的瓦尼拉和努特里维斯拉格的绝对估计误差。
在48个对应的VLM-encoder-query-set面板中,有37个单项改进了膳食。
超过一半的膳食在36/48个整餐板中有所改进,而每个物品的膳食板则有26/48个,这符合全餐取用的总效益。
然而,改良餐的数量并不一定决定总误差,因为% MAE micro/CHO\mathrm\MAE\\text{micro/CHO}也取决于单个误差的大小.
例如,GLM-5.3-Flash在整餐催化下改善了所有三个检索编码器超过一半的营养5k用餐,尽管所有三个配置中的总和主误差都增加了.
因此,配对的地块表明,取回可以使大多数膳食受益,而总体误差则以较少的大规模退化为主。

blocks.en:
Figures S7 and S9 provide complementary Bland–Altman analyses of the corresponding predictions under per-item and whole-meal prompting, respectively.
The plots show that retrieval affects not only average error but also systematic bias and dispersion, with several configurations exhibiting increasing disagreement at larger meal magnitudes.
This magnitude-dependent behaviour is particularly pronounced for Mistral-Small-3.2 on SNAPMe and EDUCATE, where large positive deviations remain visible across retrieval encoders.
Substantial between-meal dispersion and isolated large errors are also present in configurations with lower aggregate error, showing that improved average performance does not imply uniformly improved agreement.
The limits of agreement are therefore interpreted descriptively because the differences are right-skewed in several configurations and can be strongly influenced by large-error meals.
For SNAPMe, the reference nutrients are verified self-reported dietary estimates, whereas EDUCATE uses the mean CHO estimate of two dietitians; disagreement on these datasets therefore also incorporates uncertainty in the reference annotations.
Together, the paired-error and agreement analyses show that the effect of visual exemplar grounding depends on both how many meals improve and how strongly individual meal errors change.

blocks.en: S5 Exploratory Analyses
blocks.zh: S5 探索分析

blocks.en:
In addition to the main retrieval experiments and ablations, we investigate two exploratory extensions across all four evaluated VLMs.
Post-hoc food-composition grounding replaces VLM-predicted nutrient values with database-derived estimates based on predicted food identities and weights, and is therefore evaluated under per-item prompting, which provides these predictions.
Retrieval reranking instead modifies exemplar selection by rescoring visually retrieved candidates and is evaluated under both prompting strategies.
blocks.zh:
除了主要的取回实验和活化剂外,我们还调查了所有四个经评估的活化材料的两个探索性扩展。
高浓度食物分层后打地取而代之的是以基于预测食物特性和重量的数据库估算值预测的VLM营养素值,因此在逐项催化下进行评估,提供这些预测。
检索重新排序,而是通过重新评分视网膜检索候选人来修改示例选择,并在两个提示策略下进行评估。

blocks.en: S5.1 Post-Hoc Food-Composition Grounding
blocks.zh: S5.1 猪后食品组合 设地

blocks.en:
We investigate whether nutrient estimation can be improved by replacing the VLM-predicted nutrient values with values derived from a food-composition database.
This procedure requires individually identified foods and their estimated quantities, so the analysis is restricted to per-item predictions.
Each VLM-predicted food name and weight are retained; the food name is matched to a food-composition entry and scaled by the predicted weight, and the resulting item-level values are summed to obtain meal-level estimates.
blocks.zh:
我们调查是否可以通过用从食物分解数据库得出的数值来取而代之的VLM预测营养值来改进营养素估计。
这一程序需要个别识别出的食物及其估计数量,因此分析仅限于对每个项目的预测.
每个VLM预想的食物名称和重量保留;食物名称与食物分解条目相匹配并被预测的重量所缩放,由此得出的项目级值被相加以获得餐级估计.

blocks.en:
We compare one lexical and three embedding-based matching strategies.
Lexical matching selects the database entry with the highest token-set similarity to the VLM-predicted food name.
The embedding-based strategies encode the predicted food name and database entry names and select the entry with the highest cosine similarity.
We evaluate Qwen3-Embedding [ 61 ] , EmbeddingGemma [ 54 ] and Nomic Embed Text v2 (MoE) (Nomic Text) [ 36 ] .
For all strategies, the highest-scoring database entry is accepted without an additional threshold.
blocks.zh:
我们比较一个词汇学和三个嵌入式匹配策略。
Lexical 匹配选择与 VLM 预设的食品名称具有最高符号集相似性的数据库条目.
基于嵌入的策略将预测的食物名称和数据库条目名称编码,并选择有最高同位素相似性的条目.
我们评价了Qune3-Embedding [61], EmbeddingGemma [54] 和 Nomic Embed Text v2(MoE)(Nomic Text) [36].
对所有策略来说,最高得分的数据库条目被接受而不附加门槛.

blocks.en:
For Nutrition5k, SNAPMe, and MADiMa, nutrient values are obtained from the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) FoodData Central (FDC) [ 19 ] .
For EDUCATE, the predicted food name is first matched against the Dutch Food Composition Database (NEVO) [ 35 ] , with FDC used as a fallback when the highest NEVO matching score is below 0.5.
This NEVO-based configuration yields lower CHO error than FDC-only lookup across the evaluated EDUCATE configurations and is therefore reported in Table S3 .
blocks.zh:
就营养5k、SNAPMe和MADIMA而言,营养值来自美国农业部粮食数据中心[19]。
对于EDUCATE,预测的食物名称首先与荷兰食物构成数据库相匹配[35],当NEVO最高匹配分低于0.5时,FDC作为倒数.
这种基于 NEVO 的配置在评价的 EDUCATE 配置中产生的CHO 出错低于 FDC 仅搜索,因此在表 S3 中报告.

The same source prediction is used for the original NutriVisRAG estimate and all post-hoc variants, so only the food-name matching and nutrient-substitution step changes between conditions.
Embedding models are run locally on an NVIDIA RTX A6000.

blocks.en:
Table S3 reports the resulting % MAE energy \mathrm{\%MAE}_{\text{energy}} and % MAE micro/CHO \mathrm{\%MAE}_{\text{micro/CHO}} .
The analysis covers 48 model–encoder–query-set configurations (4 VLMs × \times 3 encoders × \times 4 query sets).
The original NutriVisRAG estimate achieves the lowest % MAE micro/CHO \mathrm{\%MAE}_{\text{micro/CHO}} in 46/48 configurations and the lowest % MAE energy \mathrm{\%MAE}_{\text{energy}} in 34/36 configurations where energy is available.
Lexical, EmbeddingGemma, and Nomic Text matching increase % MAE micro/CHO \mathrm{\%MAE}_{\text{micro/CHO}} in all 48 configurations, while Qwen3 increases it in 46/48.
After Benjamini–Hochberg correction, significant degradations occur in 45/48 configurations for lexical matching, 30/48 for Qwen3, 47/48 for EmbeddingGemma, and 42/48 for Nomic Text, with no significant improvement for any matching method.
Because food identification, database-match correctness, and item-weight estimation are not evaluated independently, these findings characterise the end-to-end post-hoc pipeline rather than the matching models alone.
Post-hoc food-composition grounding therefore provides no statistically significant improvement over the original NutriVisRAG predictions.
Furthermore, it adds little computational overhead: embedding-based matching takes about 150 ms per predicted food item, while lexical matching takes about 1.5 ms.
Its exclusion is therefore driven by degraded accuracy rather than computational cost.

由于食品识别,数据库匹配的正确性,以及项目重量估计等不独立评价,这些发现使得端到端的后热管的特征化,而不只是匹配模型.
因此,与最初的NutriVisRAG预测相比,在统计学上没有明显的改善。
此外,它增加了很少的计算间接费用:基于嵌入的匹配每个预测食物项目需要约150 ms,而词汇匹配则需要约1.5 ms.
因此,将其排除在外是由于准确性下降,而不是由于计算成本。

blocks.en: S5.2 Retrieval Reranking
blocks.zh: S5.2 检索

blocks.en:
We additionally investigate whether reranking a larger pool of visually retrieved candidates improves nutrient estimation.
Rather than directly presenting the five nearest neighbours returned by the visual encoder, we retrieve a larger candidate pool and apply a multimodal relevance model before selecting the final exemplars provided to the VLM.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步调查,是否将更多的可视检索候选人重新排位,从而改善营养估计。
我们不直接介绍视觉编码器返回的五个最近的邻居,而是在选择提供给甚高频仪的最后实例之前,取回一个更大的候选组合,并采用多式联运相关模型。

blocks.en:
For each query, the visual encoder first retrieves 50 candidate reference meals.
We evaluate three multimodal rerankers: Jina Reranker M0 [ 22 ] , Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B [ 26 ] , and Llama Nemotron Rerank VL 1B v2 [ 38 ] .
Jina and Qwen3 perform image-to-image reranking by scoring the query meal image against each candidate image.
Nemotron performs text-to-image reranking, for which the query meal is first converted into a short food and portion description using the same VLM used for nutrient estimation.
Each reranker rescores the 50 candidates and retains the five highest-ranked references.
blocks.zh:
每个查询,视觉编码器首先取回50份候选参考餐.
我们评价三种多式联运的调整: Jina Reranker M0 [22], Quen3-VL-Rranker-2B [26], 和 Llama Nemotron Rrank VL 1B v2 [38].
Jina和Qwen3通过对每个候选图像的查询用餐图像进行评分来进行图像到图像的重新排序.
Nemotron执行文字到图像重排,为此,查询餐首先被转换为短食物和部分描述,使用同样的用于营养素估计的VLM.
每名重新排行榜得分50名候选人,并保留5名排名最高的推荐人。

blocks.en:
The analysis uses the same fixed 100-query subsets as the retrieval ablations and evaluates both per-item and whole-meal prompting.
The evaluated checkpoints are jinaai/jina-reranker-m0, Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B, and nvidia/llama-nemotron-rerank-vl-1b-v2.
The initial candidate pool contains 50 references, which are reranked to the five exemplars presented to the VLM.
All remaining retrieval and inference settings are kept unchanged from the corresponding NutriVisRAG configuration.
The default NutriVisRAG result without reranking serves as the baseline for each model–encoder–query-set–prompt combination.
The rerankers are run locally on an NVIDIA RTX A6000.

经评估的检查站为jinaai/jina-rancer-m0,Quen/Quen3-VL-Rrancker-2B和nvidia/llama-nemotron-rank-vl-1b-v2.

blocks.en:
Under per-item prompting, reranking reduces % MAE micro/CHO \mathrm{\%MAE}_{\text{micro/CHO}} in 73/144 comparisons, with eight significant improvements and two significant degradations after Benjamini–Hochberg correction.
Improvements occur in 24/36 comparisons on MADiMa, 19/36 on Nutrition5k, 17/36 on EDUCATE, and 13/36 on SNAPMe.
Jina improves 23/48 per-item comparisons, Qwen3 improves 30/48, and Nemotron improves 20/48.
Under whole-meal prompting, reranking reduces % MAE micro/CHO \mathrm{\%MAE}_{\text{micro/CHO}} in 76/144 comparisons, with six significant improvements and four significant degradations after correction.
Improvements occur in 28/36 comparisons on MADiMa, 21/36 on EDUCATE, 17/36 on SNAPMe, and 10/36 on Nutrition5k.
Jina improves 30/48 whole-meal comparisons, while Qwen3 and Nemotron each improve 23/48.
These results indicate that reranking can reduce nutrient-estimation error in certain configurations, but its effects depend on the dataset, prompting strategy, VLM, and reranker.
Reranking adds a median of 5.3–11.7 s per meal, increasing end-to-end latency by 2.6 × 2.6\times – 5.1 × 5.1\times , depending on the reranker and VLM.
Given the variable accuracy gains and additional computational cost, reranking is retained as an exploratory extension rather than incorporated into the default NutriVisRAG pipeline.
blocks.zh:

对MADIMA的24/36比较、营养5k的19/36比较、EDUCATE的17/36比较和SNAPME的13/36比较都有所改进。
金娜改进了23/48对每个项目的比较,克文克改进了30/48,尼莫特龙改进了20/48.
在全餐提示下,再排在76/144的比较中将MAE micro/CHO\mathrm\MAE\text{micro/CHO}减少%,修正后有6个显著改进和4个显著退化.
关于MADIMA的28/36、关于EDUCATE的21/36、关于SNAPME的17/36和关于营养的10/36的比较有所改进。
吉娜改进了30/48全餐比较,而克文克和尼莫特龙则各改进了23/48.
这些结果表明,再排序可以减少某些配置中的养分估计出错,但其效果取决于数据集,促进策略,VLM和再排序.
重新排位后,每餐会增加5.3–11.7 s的中位数,根据重新排位和VLM,会增加2.6×2.6\ttimes 5.1× 5.1\tims.
鉴于精确度的可变增益和额外的计算费用,重新排序被保留为探索性扩展,而不是纳入默认的NutriVisRAG管道。
